title: Slider
description: A Slider component for displaying current value and intervals in range.
whenToUse: Used to input a value within a specified range.

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Basic slider. When `range` is `true`, display as dual thumb mode. When `disable` is `true`, the slider will not be interactable.

examples.name: Slider with InputNumber
Slider with icon
examples.description: You can add an icon beside the slider to make it meaningful.

examples.name: Customize tooltip
examples.description: Use `tooltip.formatter` to format content of `Tooltip`. If `tooltip.formatter` is null, hide it.

examples.name: Event
examples.description: The `onChange` callback function will fire when the user changes the slider's value. The `onChangeComplete` callback function will fire when `mouseup` or `keyup` fired.

examples.name: Graduated slider
examples.description: Using `marks` property to mark a graduated slider, use `value` or `defaultValue` to specify the position of thumb. When `included` is false, means that different thumbs are coordinative. when `step` is null, valid points will only be marks, `min` and `max`.

examples.name: Vertical
Control visibility of Tooltip
examples.description: When `tooltip.open` is `true`, ToolTip will always show, if set to `false` the ToolTip will not show, even if dragging or hovering.

examples.name: Reverse
Draggable track
examples.description: Make range track draggable by setting `range.draggableTrack`.

examples.name: Multiple handles
Dynamic edit nodes
examples.description: Click to add a node, drag out or press the key to delete the node.

examples.name: Disabled per handle
examples.description: Set `disabled` to an array to individually disable specific handles in range mode. Disabled handles act as movement boundaries that other handles cannot cross.

examples.name: Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Sliders by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
